description: Made from skin-friendly PU material, Xiaomi Pad 6 COver acts as a protective layer for your Xiaomi Pad 6 and attaches magnetically to the tablet. YOu can fold the cover into a triangular support position for a great movie watchign experience. Xiaomi Pad 6 senses the status of the flip cover and wakes up when you open it and goes to sleep when you close it.
